novelty.justification: The novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: the claim proposes that a distributed "set signature" contains omitted members, while "already-emitted members inhibit the retrieval of remaining ones" and thereby cause premature stopping. Searches for "LLM multi-answer set retrieval mechanism," "list enumeration internal activations cardinality," and "autoregressive answer inhibition emitted members" identified QAMPARI, RoMQA, and FanOutQA as the closest prior work, but these benchmark multi-answer completeness or fan-out reasoning rather than explaining omissions through an internal set representation and sequential inhibition. Moving from those behavioral studies to the claimed set-signature-plus-inhibition account requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although the individual tools—linear probing, attention knockout, and residual-stream projection—are standard, making this a high-novelty contribution within an established framework rather than a new paradigm.
